p1_indicators: active ventilator alarm with a reported fall in delivered tidal volume
reported oxygen saturation below 92 percent during the device alarm
bedside team using manual ventilation while technical review is requested

required_actions.assignee: current ventilator on-call specialist from on_call_roster.json
required_actions.resolution_boundary: Do not resolve before a specialist review and documented acknowledgement.

verification: Read the same conversation after the assignment request and confirm its conversation ID, status, assignee ID, and latest inbound message. A mutation response alone is not verification.
final_report: Report the conversation ID, selected agent ID and name, observed final status, assignment verification result, and SLA deadline. Do not repeat clinical measurements or sender contact details.
